high_level_description: The image features a close-up of an hourglass, which is a classic symbol of the passage of time. The hourglass consists of two glass bulbs connected by a narrow neck, with sand or a similar granular substance flowing from one bulb to the other as time passes. The hourglass appears to be made of dark wood, giving it a vintage or antique look. The background is a plain, light beige color, which contrasts with the dark wood and the clear glass of the hourglass, making the object stand out prominently. There are no people or other objects in the image, and the focus is entirely on the hourglass.
